description: ImplementedFLCM_Lighting, the interface specification body_can.dbc handed to the FLCM supplier, satisfies the interface side of EL-HAZ-1.3 (FLCM_Lighting_HazardWarning) and EL-BEAM-1.3 (FLCM_Lighting_BeamModes): FLCM is a receiver of TurnLightControl and of the three beam control frames. test_turn_lights.py observes TurnLightControl at the FLCM-BodyCan0 namespace, i.e. at the FLCM's input.
The lamp reaction window of EL-RSP-1.3 (FLCM_Lighting_IndicatorResponseTime) and the DRL dimming are supplier commitments, used as inputs by EL_Indicator_Response_Time_Analysis.md.
metadata.name: SatisfactionClaim_NonSafety_ImplementedFLCM_Lighting
